name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted.
Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows at 45 degrees.
Press the bar up until arms are straight.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to a 30 degree incline.
Lower the bar to the upper chest.
Press up and slightly back until arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower both dumbbells until they are level with the chest.
Press up until arms are straight.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a 30 degree incline.
Lower the dumbbells to the upper chest.
Press up until arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above the chest.
Open the arms with a slight elbow bend until the chest stretches.
Bring the dumbbells together without locking the elbows.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set both pulleys above shoulder height.
Step forward with a slight forward lean.
Bring the handles together in front of the chest and return slowly.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Set hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lower the chest near the floor and press back up.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lift the body.
Lean slightly forward and lower until the shoulders are below the elbows.
Press back up without swinging.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with the chest.
Press the handles forward until arms are straight.
Return slowly until the chest stretches.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are level with the shoulders.
Press the pads together in front of the chest.
Open the arms slowly until the chest stretches.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under the bar and grip just outside the legs.
Brace the core and drive through the floor.
Stand tall with the bar close to the body, then lower under control.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward until the torso is near 45 degrees.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs.
Lower the bar with control without rounding the back.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Set the torso parallel to the floor.
Pull the bar explosively to the lower chest.
Return the bar to the floor on every rep.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar wider than shoulders and sit tall.
Pull the bar to the upper chest with the elbows down.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing away.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing you.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with knees slightly bent and back straight.
Pull the handle to the lower ribs.
Return slowly without rounding the back.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one hand and knee on a bench.
Pull the dumbbell toward the hip.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the bar and hinge forward with a flat back.
Pull the handles toward the chest.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley with a slight hinge.
Keep the arms straight and pull the bar to the thighs.
Return slowly until the lats stretch.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Set the hips on the pad with feet secured.
Hinge down with a neutral spine.
Raise the torso until the body is in a straight line.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at upper chest height.
Pull the rope toward the forehead with elbows high.
Return slowly while keeping tension.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with the bar at shoulder height and grip just outside the shoulders.
Brace the core and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to the shoulders with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower to shoulder height with control.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of the shoulders with palms facing you.
Rotate the palms outward while pressing overhead.
Reverse the rotation while lowering.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at the sides and a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Raise one or both arms to shoulder height.
Lower slowly with control.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back and dumbbells hanging down.
Raise the arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Stand with the bar in front of the thighs.
Pull the bar up to the lower chest with elbows high.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Press the handles overhead.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with an underhand grip on the bar.
Curl the bar to the chest without swinging.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at the sides and palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells toward the shoulders.
Lower slowly with control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl the dumbbells toward the shoulders.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Set the upper arms on the preacher pad.
Curl the bar up without lifting the elbows.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low pulley with an underhand grip.
Curl the handle to the chest.
Return slowly while keeping tension.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with arms hanging down.
Curl the dumbbells while keeping the elbows still.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip the bar at shoulder width on a flat bench.
Lower the bar to the lower chest with elbows close.
Press up until arms are straight.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley with elbows at the sides.
Push the bar down until the arms are straight.
Return slowly to a 90 degree elbow bend.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind the head with elbows close.
Extend the arms to raise the dumbbell.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding the bar above the chest.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward the forehead.
Extend the arms without moving the upper arms.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Place the hands on a bench behind the body.
Lower the hips until the elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up until the arms are straight.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Place the hands close together under the chest.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lower the chest and press back up.

name: Back Squat
instructions: Place the bar on the upper back and stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat until the thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through the floor to stand tall.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Rest the bar on the front shoulders with elbows high.
Squat with an upright torso.
Drive up to a standing position.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at the chest.
Squat with the chest tall and knees tracking out.
Stand back up and squeeze the glutes.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Set the seat so the knees start near 90 degrees.
Press the platform away without locking the knees.
Lower slowly until the knees reach 90 degrees.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at the sides and step forward.
Lower until both knees are near 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot into the next step.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place the rear foot on a bench and hold dumbbells.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit with the pad on the lower shins.
Extend the knees until the legs are straight.
Lower slowly without dropping the weight.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Set the shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform.
Squat until the knees reach 90 degrees.
Press back up without locking the knees.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar at the thighs and a soft knee bend.
Hinge at the hips until the hamstrings stretch.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar at the thighs and a slight knee bend.
Lower the bar along the legs with a flat back.
Squeeze the hamstrings and glutes to stand.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad on the lower calves.
Curl the heels toward the glutes.
Lower slowly without letting the weight drop.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit with the pad on the lower calves.
Curl the heels under the seat.
Return slowly with control.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel with the ankles secured.
Lower the torso forward as slowly as possible.
Push off the floor or pull with the hamstrings to return.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Place the bar on the upper back and soften the knees.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Drive the hips forward to stand.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with the upper back on a bench and the bar over the hips.
Drive the hips up until the body is level.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet flat.
Press through the heels to lift the hips.
Lower slowly without resting the hips.

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley.
Kick the working leg back with a slight knee bend.
Return slowly while keeping the hips square.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes out.
Grip the bar inside the legs and brace the core.
Drive through the floor and stand tall.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Hold dumbbells and place one foot on a box.
Drive through the top foot to stand on the box.
Step down slowly and repeat.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of the feet on the platform.
Raise the heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly until the calves stretch.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with the pads on the knees and feet on the platform.
Press the heels up as high as possible.
Lower slowly until the calves stretch.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Hinge forward with the hips under the pad.
Raise the heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly until the calves stretch.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot with the heel off a step.
Raise the heel as high as possible.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Plank
instructions: Set the forearms on the floor under the shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Brace the core and hold without sagging.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on one side with the forearm under the shoulder.
Lift the hips into a straight line.
Hold without letting the hips drop.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise the legs until they are parallel to the floor.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the rope at the head.
Crunch the ribs toward the hips.
Return slowly while keeping tension.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel with the wheel under the shoulders.
Roll forward while keeping the core braced.
Pull back to the start without arching the back.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with the knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the ball at the chest.
Rotate the torso side to side without rounding the back.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on the back with arms up and knees at 90 degrees.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on the back with hands behind the head.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Alternate sides without pulling the neck.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with the forearms resting on the thighs and palms up.
Curl the wrists upward.
Lower slowly until the fingers stretch.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with the forearms on the thighs and palms down.
Raise the backs of the hands upward.
Lower slowly with control.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell in each hand at the sides.
Walk with a tall posture and steady steps.
Set the weights down with a flat back.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with the kettlebell in front of the hips.
Hinge and swing the bell back between the legs.
Drive the hips forward to swing the bell to chest height.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat down and place the hands on the floor.
Jump the feet back and perform a push-up.
Jump the feet forward and stand or jump up.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Drive one knee toward the chest.
Alternate legs quickly while keeping the hips low.

name: Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells at the shoulders and squat down.
Drive up from the squat.
Press the dumbbells overhead as the legs straighten.

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on the back holding a kettlebell above one shoulder.
Roll to the elbow, then the hand, and sweep the leg through.
Stand up while keeping the bell overhead, then reverse the movement.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Grip the sled handles with a forward lean.
Drive through the legs with short powerful steps.
Push to the finish and walk back to recover.
